scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it recently and was hoping to get an update.
dialogue.agent: Your housing loan application, with ID LOAN-01069, has been denied.

dialogue.user: Oh, no. Denied? That's disappointing. Could you tell me why my application was denied?
dialogue.agent: The principal reasons for the denial of your application are credit history.

dialogue.user: I see. Could you tell me what my interest rate would have been if my application had been approved?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate is not applicable in this case, as the application was denied.

dialogue.user: Okay, I understand. And what about the total costs associated with the loan? Would those have been applicable if it had been approved?
dialogue.agent: The total loan costs are not applicable in this case, as the application was denied.

dialogue.user: That's a shame. Is there any way I can find out more about what aspects of my credit history led to this decision? I'd like to understand what I can work on.
dialogue.agent: I can confirm that credit history was a reason for the denial. The loan record does not include specific underwriting details regarding the credit history review.

dialogue.user: This is quite discouraging. I had hoped for a different outcome. Thank you for your time. <Dissatisfied> I am dissatisfied because, while I understand my application was denied due to credit history, I was hoping for more specific information that could help me improve my credit for future applications, and I was unable to get details on potential loan terms even though I asked.
